title: news-social-methods
universal_lens: Social-signal fusion operates as a hierarchical Bayesian update where raw textual sentiment acts as a likelihood function over an exogenous market prior. The resulting posterior distribution is strictly constrained by the Kullback-Leibler divergence, ensuring that high-variance social noise cannot arbitrarily override robust structural priors without overwhelming statistical evidence.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps unstructured X-intake into conformal prediction sets via meta-calibrated shrinkage fits. Sentiment polarity vectors are treated as auxiliary features in a Random Forest classifier, where out-of-bag error estimates provide rigorous bounds on the epistemic uncertainty of crowd-sourced predictive signals against historical baselines.
gse_mapping: Within GSE, news fusion triggers state-transitions only when the marginal information gain exceeds a strict Brier-score improvement gate. If the base prior is a de-vigged market read, social signals must demonstrate orthogonal alpha to prevent redundant calibration of already efficient public probabilities.

primitives.name: Prior Load-Bearing Ablation Test
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **"Prior carries the weight":** ablation removing the prior drops FutureX below the monolithic baseline (**0.6427 vs 0.6512**, ECE 0.2134) — the prior is the load-bearing component.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: FutureX: Benchmark score (dimensionless performance metric); Monolithic baseline: Single-model performance score (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: The structural prior contains non-redundant information relative to the aggregated social signals.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the prior is entirely collinear with the social signal noise, rendering the fusion mechanism mathematically superfluous.

layer2.mapping: Establishes the mathematical necessity of retaining the de-vigged market prior in GSE before applying any news-fusion updates.
layer2.telemetry: Performance drop to 0.6427 upon prior removal.

primitives.name: NLP Feature Extraction and Classification Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Pipeline: CMU ARK TwitterNLP POS tagger (adjectives/verbs/nouns/adverbs/interjections/emoticons) → Porter stemming → chi-square-ranked bigrams, ~11–15 features per side → RF/NB/LR/SVM, 100 seeds, LOOCV.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: POS: Part-of-Speech tags (categorical); Bigrams: N-gram frequency counts (integers); RF: Random Forest ensemble classifier.
primitives.assumptions: Syntactic structures and specific bigram frequencies in social text map linearly to latent team performance variables.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Suffers from data leakage if feature selection (chi-square) is performed globally rather than strictly within time-ordered cross-validation folds.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI's corpus-intelligence lane, converting raw X-intake into structured, scored trust signals.
layer2.telemetry: Random Forest accuracy of 65.6% ± 4.33% on Twitter-only data.

reasoning_traces.think:
The integration of social signals into quantitative sports modeling fundamentally relies on treating unstructured text as a noisy likelihood function applied to a robust structural prior. The LEAP framework demonstrates that expected calibration error (ECE) can be halved when external agent frameworks iteratively refine the posterior distribution, effectively shrinking overconfident predictions toward empirical reality. However, the ablation studies reveal a critical dependency: the prior is load-bearing. When the prior—often a de-vigged market read—is removed, the system's performance collapses below monolithic baselines. This implies that social sentiment does not generate alpha in isolation; rather, it acts as a conditional adjustment kernel that only yields positive marginal gains if the base prior leaves exploitable inefficiencies. The NLP pipeline utilizing chi-square-ranked bigrams and Random Forest classifiers provides the mechanistic engine for this likelihood extraction. Yet, the mathematical validity of this extraction is highly sensitive to temporal leakage. Performing feature selection across the entire corpus violates the causal ordering required for true out-of-sample validation. Therefore, the sovereign primitive here is not merely sentiment analysis, but a rigorously gated Bayesian update where the social signal's influence is bounded by its ability to demonstrably reduce the Brier score beyond what the market prior already achieves.

It modernizes these concepts by replacing human experts with LLM-aggregated social sentiment, while inheriting the classical statistical requirement that new information must be orthogonal to existing priors to justify a belief update. Social actors, conversely, are driven by tribal bias and emotional volatility. The quantitative engine must model this duality, recognizing that beating the market requires extracting the tiny fraction of genuine, forward-looking signal hidden beneath the massive noise floor of fan sentiment.
